description: Fully synthetic training data for the KPI Prediction & Deviation Agent, predicting each batch's FINAL outcome (not a 30-min-ahead snapshot) from the last 30 minutes of process parameters available at any point in the batch. Final KPIs are derived through the same physical dependency chain as the real historical generator (Process Parameters -> Stability -> Yield/Energy/Assay -> OEE), fed by synthetic deviation scores instead of real measurements - see this script's module docstring for the full rationale.
row_grain: many rows per synthetic batch (one per elapsed minute from 30 to the batch's end), all sharing that batch's single final-outcome target - only the input window differs row to row
weight_column_note: Training weight per row, NOT a model input feature - 0.15 for rows sampled before any of the batch's actual drifting parameters could have started (genuinely unpredictable from input alone), 1.0 otherwise. Pass as sample_weight when fitting, do not include in feature_columns.
